title: Mockup Updates — v1.3
subtitle: All changes between version 1.2 and version 1.3 of the Wafra Farm App mockup, screen by screen.

screens.name: Sign up
notes: Mobile number is now validated with a six-digit code. Email is collected but not verified, so no one gets locked out over a bounced address.
Sign-in still accepts either. Registration requires a verified number because that's where work alerts and worker records go.
Replaced the "type either one" flow with dedicated number and email fields.

screens.name: Verify code
notes: The verification code always goes to the mobile number — email alone can't be used to enter the account.

screens.name: Your details and units
notes: Acre removed from the measurement options, app-wide. Dunum and hectare only.

screens.name: Add your first farm
notes: "Draw my plots myself" renamed to "Draw my own plots".
Each route now explains when to choose it — they serve different needs, and the choice affects what gets quoted.
The survey route mentions that plots can still be removed from the result afterwards.
Satellite strip replaced by the new coverage question.

screens.name: What should we cover?
notes: New question asked before the survey: crops, trees, or both. This filters the survey result and plan pages, so a date grower isn't quoted for fallow ground.
Farm naming moved here from the drawing screen. An optional field lets the farmer choose a name; left blank, it's numbered automatically.
"What is growing here" no longer asked — the survey detects it, so we avoid asking for something we already know.

screens.name: Draw my own plots
notes: Crop picker below the canvas removed.
The farmer names each plot instead. Left blank, it's numbered automatically.
Traced plots are now listed on the same screen, with rename and remove options — no need to restart the flow to fix a mistake.

screens.name: Survey my whole farm
notes: "Send for survey" changed to "Send for quote" — the quote is what the farmer is waiting for.
Farm-name field and auto-name explanation removed — naming now happens on the previous screen (A12).
Simplified to one unit throughout the app. Hectares show one decimal place.

screens.name: What we found
notes: Structures removed from the survey entirely — building detection sits outside the scope of a farm service.
Plot name on the left, actions on the right: Keep, Remove, Edit.
Remove greys the row instead of deleting it, and Keep brings it straight back.
Plot edits consolidated into a four-tool toolbar — Join, Split, Remove, Add — each asking which plots to apply to.
Removed the "left out" total and the note about keeping a record of removed ground.
Confirm button moved into the totals box, so it appears once the farmer has reviewed the full list.
Trees-only farms now show a count and a tree-type picker instead of plot-by-plot options.
Plots carry their final names from the start: farm name plus a number.
No pricing on this screen — pricing comes after scope is confirmed.

screens.name: Your plan and price
notes: The 30-day free trial now leads the page, front and centre.
"Compare all features" moved to the top, where it's easier to find before choosing.
Both Choose buttons use the same neutral colour, and the "Most chosen" badge is gone.
Annual option with its 15% discount shown on each card, as a saving off the monthly figure.
The page confirms that permission is asked before any payment.
Warnings grouped together at the end under "Before you buy".

screens.name: Home
notes: "All farms" tab renamed to "All plots" — it lists plots, so the label now matches the content.
Plot names include the farm name in this cross-farm list (e.g. Al Kharj North P1), so they're clear out of context.

screens.name: Farm detail
notes: Simplified to three metrics: Plant health, Water stress, Nutrition status.
Water stress moved to second position — in this region it's the most time-sensitive indicator.
"Growth and vigour" removed as a top-level metric; it's part of plant health. Still available on the plot page and map.
Removed the "imagery from…" date line. Image age already shows on the farm card and the plot's date stepper.

screens.name: Plots
notes: Added a colour legend at the top, drawn from the status scale so it always matches the rows.
Plots with issues now link directly to the relevant advice.
Farm-qualified names in the all-farms view; short form within a single farm.

screens.name: Plot detail
notes: Measures, date stepper, and explanatory content kept as they were.
Irrigation parameters (efficiency, soil type, flow rate) moved here, editable from the plot's own settings. They belong to the plot and carry across recommendations.

screens.name: Crop cycles
notes: When the satellite detects a different crop, both values are shown with clear options: "Update with satellite data" or "Keep as is".
Standardised on "Planting date" as the label.
Harvest date is now system-generated and clearly marked as an estimate.
Crop name removed from plot names — seasonal plots would otherwise need renaming each cycle.

screens.name: Add / edit crop cycle
notes: Expected harvest date field removed — it was rarely revisited after being set.
Simplified to "Planting date" (was "Sowing or planting date").
Only the crop and planting date are asked for now.

screens.name: Tree list
notes: Added filtering by tree type and by variety — growers think at both levels, and on a single-species farm only the variety filter is useful.
Each filter only appears when there's more than one option.

screens.name: Tree detail
notes: "Chlorophyll" renamed to "Nutrient content" — it's closer to how farmers think about it.
Upgrade copy now reads "Soil nutrient content".

screens.name: Add farm
notes: Warning threshold moved from five farms to ten, matching the actual limit.
Route wording and guidance match the first-run fork.

screens.name: Map
notes: Measure selector is now a bordered dropdown with a "Showing" label, making it easier to discover.

screens.name: Layers
notes: Simplified to two base maps (Terrain removed).
Each base map now includes a short description explaining the trade-off between clarity and freshness.
Land use layer removed — outside the scope of a farm app.
Irrigation map removed — the water stress measure layer already covers this, and the screen now says so.
Advanced map layers and Variable rate maps groups removed entirely, along with their feature keys and plan-comparison entries.

screens.name: Advice inbox
notes: Simplified to two actions: Assign and Ignore.
"Mark as complete" removed from advice cards — completing work happens on the task screen, by the person doing the work.
Once advice has been assigned, the card links to the task instead of offering to create another.
"Send them all to one person" assigns every waiting item to one person (defaults to the supervisor), and can be left on as a standing rule.

screens.name: Irrigation advice
notes: Irrigation efficiency rating shown at the top for this plot.
Simplified to one weekly total instead of repeating the same figure in different units.
Recommendation framed as a change from usual practice (e.g. "an increase of 20%"), which is easier to act on.
Added a day-by-day schedule with a time for each irrigation.
Times shown as a two-hour window — more honest than a precise start time when flow rate isn't measured.
One schedule per plot, clearly stated. Per-tree schedules aren't practical to carry out.
Over- and under-watering feedback included as a clear direction to increase or reduce.

screens.name: Nutrition advice
notes: Diagnosis and Assumptions removed here too — this screen is for the person doing the work, and the technical detail belongs in the advisory log.
All model inputs are still recorded in the advisory log, accessible from the ⋯ menu.

screens.name: Crop protection advice
notes: Diagnosis removed. The practical details — active ingredient, rate, pre-harvest interval, label warning — are kept as they were.

screens.name: Tasks
notes: SUGGESTED section removed. Tasks are created by assigning advice — there's a clear moment when something becomes work.
Ignore button removed from the task list.
The list now only contains assigned work, so the task count reflects real commitments.

screens.name: Task detail
notes: "Mark as done" is a task-level action and lives on this screen.
For tasks raised from advice, completion opens the advised-vs-applied record — a useful check on what was actually done.

screens.name: Compare plans
notes: Restructured: Basic and Pro are rows within each feature group, and Pro only lists what it adds. Clearer than the old two-column layout.
Filtered to the service the account holds; tabs only appear for combined accounts.
Consistent group order for crops and trees, with satellite and imagery first in both.
Seventeen features renamed for clarity (e.g. comparison maps, farm advisory, soil nutrient content).
Ten features removed (historical weather, time series, expert opinion, Agro Doctor, and others).
Multi-user access and languages moved into "In every plan" — they're the same on both tiers.

screens.name: Language and region
notes: Added a 24-hour / a.m.–p.m. setting for the irrigation schedule's time windows.

screens.name: Choose a measure
notes: Each measure now has its own block with breathing room — easier to read and choose from.

screens.name: Plot tool picker — new
notes: Choosing a tool on A11 now asks which plots it applies to, making the multi-plot operations easier to find and use.

screens.name: Send them all to one person — new
notes: Every waiting piece of advice becomes a task for one person, due when the app suggested.
The supervisor is offered first, since that's the most common choice.
"Keep doing this" makes it a standing rule. What was sent and to whom stays visible, and it can be turned off from the same place.

screens.name: How we calculate for this plot
notes: Previously opened from an "Assumptions we used" block on each advice screen.
Now opens from the plot's own settings on B4 — efficiency, soil type, and flow rate belong to the plot, not to a single recommendation.
